race.comment: PALLADIUM (1) only warmed into late when resuming at Wangaratta and looks much better suited here stretching to the mile. Gets a key booking in Loy, who will have him blending in at just the right time. DESTINED TO DREAM (8) drifted well back and failed to finish it off last start when tenth over 1800m at Gundagai. Finds a more suitable contest and can fill a drum at a big quote. KAMAROOKA (4) has a moderate winning strike-rate but performed well last time at Goulburn, finishing third and only 1.5 lengths from the winner at the end of 2100m after being prominent at the corner. Beautifully placed and is sure to be there at the finish. KAYLA MARIE (10) is a two-start maiden who placed on debut then could only manage seventh last start, beaten 5 lengths over 1400m at Gundagai. Should settle in the leading division. Plenty of scope for improvement.
